column1: # Revenga 1822 (catalogue 641), second transcription pass, 17 Nov 2026 (work of 12 Nov 2026).
# Every place where the first-pass transcription (transcription.txt, C-groups) and the blind second transcription
# (blind/transcription_blind.tsv, B-groups) differ (kind differ), or agree only on a doubtful or alternative reading
# (kind doubt), with the reading settled on the frame. both-agree = both transcriptions read alike and the frame
# shows something else. reading_1 = first pass; reading_2 = blind; pos = sign index in the group (characters, ll = 2).
# method: shape = settled by the letter shape on the frame; sense = the shape could not decide, settled from the
# decrypted sense; open = not settled. note = what the frame shows. Frames: NARA T33 roll 3, T33-03-0055 to -0058.
# The settling was done by one AI agent that could see both transcriptions: it is not blind.
